web_search.title: A first sourdough loaf
web_search.snippets:
A first sourdough loaf
Feed the starter twice a day for six days. On day seven, mix the dough in the morning, fold it four times, and bake in a covered pot at 230 C for 45 minutes.

reply.judge: She read the shared page and says what it is about (a sourdough guide: feeding the starter, baking on day seven) instead of saying she cannot open links or guessing from the address.
